$schema: Layer 0 bootstrap configuration for the template. Every key is optional; anything omitted falls back to the value compiled into the application, so an untouched file behaves exactly like no file at all.
$deployment: In production this file lives BESIDE the application bundle, not inside it — the marketplace installer copies the bundle directory with overwrite="true" and would destroy customer edits. `resolveBootstrapConfigUrl()` looks for it one level up from the base href, which is why it is served here from `public/agentic-ui-config/`.
$nuxeoApiOrigin: Origin for Nuxeo REST calls. Empty keeps requests relative, correct behind a dev proxy and for same-origin production.
$manifestDocumentPath: Repository path of the Nuxeo document holding the Layer 1 manifest. The template ships no Nuxeo server, so this will not resolve and the application will fall back to packaged defaults — visible on the home page under 'Configuration sources'. That fallback is the demonstration, not a failure.
$branding: Rendered by the shell and written to document.title. Change these two strings and reload — no rebuild.
$themes: Merged over the packaged themes by id. `tokens` are CSS custom properties applied to <html>, so a rebrand needs no rebuild.
